source.citation: Clemens PL, et al. Clin Pharmacokinet. 2017;56(8):915-924, electronic supplementary material 1.
source.storage: Kept on the platform owner's computer only; not committed.
source.extraction: AI-assisted from the Word document XML (tables) and the embedded figure image (Supplemental Fig. 1, viewed). Independent review pending.

design_supplemental_figure_1.gen501_part1: 0.005-24 mg/kg; first infusion followed by a 3-week washout, then weekly for up to 7 full infusions (n = 32). All Part 1 patients received a pre-dose 1 day before the first two full infusions.
design_supplemental_figure_1.gen501_part2_8_mg_kg: Cohorts A, B, C: weekly for 8 weeks, every 2 weeks for 16 weeks, every 4 weeks (n = 30). Cohorts A and B received 1 pre-dose infusion 1 day before the first full infusion; cohort C did not (pre-dose amount not stated).
design_supplemental_figure_1.gen501_part2_16_mg_kg: Cohorts D, E: first infusion followed by a 3-week washout; then weekly for 7 weeks, every 2 weeks for 14 weeks, every 4 weeks (n = 42). No pre-dose.
design_supplemental_figure_1.sirius_part1: Randomised: 8 mg/kg every 4 weeks (n = 18); 16 mg/kg weekly for 8 weeks, every 2 weeks for 16 weeks, every 4 weeks (n = 16).
design_supplemental_figure_1.sirius_part2: 16 mg/kg as in Part 1 (n = 106 including 90 additional patients).

patients_with_pk_samples_supplemental_ta.note: Patients with measurable samples, all parts and dose groups combined.

baseline_supplemental_table_2.population: Patients with measurable PK concentrations; all doses and parts of each study combined (not by dose group).
notes: The table's row label reads 'Type of melanoma at baseline by immunofixation'; the IgG/non-IgG split is read as the myeloma type.
The combined medians (78.6 kg, 37 g/L) equal the reference values in the Luo 2021 covariate equations, consistent with Luo carrying over the earlier GEN501/SIRIUS model's covariate model.

Some printed counts are internally inconsistent (e.g. combined creatinine clearance >= 90 mL/min '17 (32)' while the study counts sum to 71; GEN501 'IMiD only 12 (14)' summing to 14 combined). Not used here.
